name: SP1 — Stage failure raises StageError and run returns partial results

scenarios.name: SP1-GD-08 derivation stage failure raises StageError with context

steps.text: an LLM that returns an invalid response for <stage>
the <stage> derivation is attempted
a StageError is raised
the StageError carries stage <stage_name>
the StageError carries step <step_name>
the failed call is logged with success=false

scenarios.name: SP1-GD-09 Stage 1a failure preserves the capability profile from Stage 1b

steps.text: an LLM that returns an invalid response for stage_1a
the full SP1 run is executed
the run returns a partial SP1RunResult
the stage_errors list contains the stage_1a failure
loss_analysis is None
capability_profile is not None
control_structure is None
a run manifest is written

scenarios.name: SP1-GD-10 Stage 1b failure sets profile to None and skips Stage 2

steps.text: an LLM that returns valid responses for stage_1a
an LLM that returns an invalid response for stage_1b
the full SP1 run is executed
the run returns a partial SP1RunResult
the stage_errors list contains the stage_1b failure
loss_analysis is not None
capability_profile is None
control_structure is None
a run manifest is written

scenarios.name: SP1-GD-11 Stage 2 failure preserves loss_analysis and profile

steps.text: an LLM that returns valid responses for stage_1a and stage_1b
an LLM that returns an invalid response for stage_2
the full SP1 run is executed
the run returns a partial SP1RunResult
the stage_errors list contains the stage_2 failure
loss_analysis is not None
capability_profile is not None
control_structure is None
a run manifest is written

scenarios.name: SP1-GD-12 failed derivation call logged with success=false and error message

steps.text: an LLM that returns an invalid response for stage_1a
the full SP1 run is executed
a call log entry exists with success=false
the call log entry stage is stage_1a
the call log entry step is risk_derivation
the call log entry has an error message field

scenarios.name: SP1-GD-13 pipeline does not crash on any single stage validation failure

steps.text: an LLM that returns an invalid response for stage_2
the full SP1 run is executed
the pipeline does not raise an exception
a partial SP1RunResult is returned

scenarios.name: SP1-GD-14 derivation stage LLM exception raises StageError and logs failure

steps.text: an LLM that raises a RuntimeError during stage_1a
the full SP1 run is executed
the run returns a partial SP1RunResult
the stage_errors list contains the stage_1a failure
a call log entry exists with success=false

scenarios.name: SP1-GD-15 run manifest records stage_errors on partial failure

steps.text: an LLM that returns an invalid response for stage_1b
the full SP1 run is executed
a run manifest is written
the manifest contains a stage_errors field
the stage_errors field includes the stage_1b failure description

background.text: the STPA system model run module is importable
a use-case description and risk extraction JSON are available as input
